## Summary

Guardrails: never git add -A, explicit pathspecs; HARNESS_NO_TELEMETRY=1 timeout 30 git commit --no-verify; invoke the CLI as node harness/cli/bin/harness.js; never link the global harness; fence is this worktree + docs/plans/075-windows-nudge-honesty only.
